findings.title: Hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials in Deployment env
findings.remediation: Load RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER and RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS via secretKeyRef.

findings.title: Excessive Secret exposure via envFrom (cross-service DB DSN access)
findings.evidence: Each microservice receives only its own DB DSN and required keys via secretKeyRef
findings.remediation: Replace broad envFrom secretRef with scoped per-service secretKeyRef env entries.

findings.title: Pod Security Standards (Restricted): drop ALL capabilities & RuntimeDefault seccomp
findings.evidence: All 8 app Deployments drop ALL Linux capabilities and enforce RuntimeDefault seccomp

findings.title: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy isolation (default-deny + least-privilege flows)
findings.remediation: Add default-deny-ingress NetworkPolicy and explicit allow policies per tier.
